A0_A1.title: Cozy Studio Flat
A0_A1.visualDescription: Small studio flat with a big sunny window, yellow sofa, and small kitchen.

pages.bio: I am a small studio flat. I have one room, a yellow sofa, a small kitchen, and a clean bathroom.
I am near the bus stop and the supermarket. I am cheap and cozy for one student.

A0_A1.opener: Welcome! Do you like small cozy flats or big houses?
A0_A1.prompt: Name 3 things inside this studio flat using simple words.

A0_A1.title: Red Brick House
A0_A1.visualDescription: Two-story red brick house with a green lawn and white fence.

pages.bio: I am a red brick house. I have two bedrooms, one living room, a garage, and a green garden.
I am on a quiet green street. My garden is good for dogs and children.

A0_A1.opener: Hello! Do you like a green garden or a city flat?
icebreakers: I prefer living in the city!
A0_A1.prompt: Is this house in a city or a quiet village? How many bedrooms does it have?

A2.title: Modern Loft Apartment
A2.visualDescription: Industrial loft with high concrete ceilings, large glass windows, leather couch, and kitchen island.

pages.bio: This is a spacious one-bedroom industrial loft. It has high ceilings, large glass windows, and a modern open kitchen island.
It is located in the Arts District near art galleries and coffee shops, so you can walk everywhere easily.

A2.opener: Hi! Do you like big industrial lofts with city views?
A2.prompt: Describe the main features of this loft apartment and its location.

A2.title: Suburban Cottage with Garden
A2.visualDescription: Cozy stone cottage with flower boxes, wooden porch swing, lawn, and chimney.

pages.bio: This is a charming three-bedroom suburban cottage. It features a cozy stone fireplace, a sunny porch, and a flower garden.
It is in a peaceful neighborhood near primary schools and bicycle paths, which makes it perfect for families.

A2.opener: Hello! Would you like to sit on the porch swing and enjoy the garden?
A2.prompt: Compare this suburban cottage with the city loft apartment using A2 vocabulary.

B1.title: Converted Paper Mill Loft
B1.visualDescription: Historic paper mill converted into a luxury loft with exposed red brick, heavy timber beams, and river views.

pages.bio: This 2-bedroom loft is located inside a converted 19th-century paper mill that successfully combines original exposed brickwork and timber beams with contemporary interior design.
Residents enjoy a private balcony overlooking the riverfront promenade, integrated smart lighting, an underground garage, and exclusive fitness center access.

B1.opener: Welcome! Do you prefer historic renovated properties or brand-new minimalist architecture?
B1.prompt: Evaluate the architectural contrast between historic industrial brickwork and modern fixtures.

B1.title: Eco-Friendly Solar Villa
B1.visualDescription: Sustainable two-story villa with rooftop solar panels, rainwater harvesting, vertical plant wall, and timber deck.

pages.bio: This innovative 3-bedroom zero-emission villa is powered by rooftop solar panels and relies on triple-pane insulation and rainwater collection to minimize environmental impact.
Key features include an organic vegetable garden patch, an electric vehicle charging dock, an indoor vertical plant wall, and negligible energy bills.

B1.opener: Greetings! How important is sustainable eco-friendly engineering when selecting a residence?
B1.prompt: Describe the sustainable technologies integrated into this eco-friendly villa.

B2.title: Penthouse Sky Villa
B2.visualDescription: Luxury penthouse terrace featuring a private glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree skyline panoramas, and smart automation.

pages.bio: This exquisite 4,500 sq ft top-floor Sky Villa features a private cantilevered glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree panoramic skyline vistas, and biometric smart automation.
The residence offers keyless direct elevator access, a climate-controlled sommelier wine cellar, motorized curtain glass facades, and rooftop helipad privileges.

redFlags: ✗ Slight high-altitude structural sway in severe storms

B2.opener: Welcome to the sky! To what degree does high-end architectural luxury justify its ecological and socio-urban footprint?
B2.prompt: Analyze the architectural engineering, structural dynamics, and urban exclusivity of high-rise penthouse living.

B2.title: Alpine Timber Chalet
B2.visualDescription: Rustic timber chalet set in alpine pine forests, featuring cathedral glass windows, cedar sauna, and stone hearth.

pages.bio: Nestled into alpine slopes, this magnificent 4-bedroom timber chalet showcases double-height cathedral windows framing snow-draped pine valleys and a massive granite fireplace.
The estate provides ski-in/ski-out convenience, an outdoor cedar wood sauna, geothermal radiant floor heating, and handcrafted oak joinery by local artisans.

greenFlags: ✓ Immediate proximity to alpine ski resorts
redFlags: ✗ Intermittent road blockages during severe blizzards

B2.opener: Greetings! Would you thrive immersed in mountain isolation, or do you require urban velocity to stay stimulated?
B2.prompt: Evaluate how residing in isolated natural topography influences psychological well-being and daily routine.
